description: 第11回の全文と装飾、個人と一般集団、構想と実移動を区別する。
rules: 参照専用原文199〜214頁の全407行を保持する。65通常本文行を10紙面接続で55段落とし4節122場面へ分ける。
本人15点・集団9点・建物と道具4点の新作28点を本文へ対応させる。
3C政策は3本の静的な関係線。株式買収や権利の承認を人や船の旅程にしない。
本文と親段落に明記された出発・到着のみ8本の移動で示す。国・地域代表間の概略で実際の出港地や道順は補わない。
ファショダの対峙は非交戦。仮定の援軍、ドイツへの警戒と英海軍の出動準備を実現させない。
ボーア人とブール人、ウラービーとオラービー、セシル＝ローズとローズは同じ対象。ジョゼフ＝チェンバレンと後世の別人を混ぜない。
ベルリン＝コンゴ会議と東方問題のベルリン会議、植民地と自治領、事実上と正式な保護国化を分ける。
白人側の差別を原文の批判とともに保持し、人種隔離の制度や虐殺を称揚しない。
共通の経度32度・緯度24度の拡大上限を維持する。

assets.name: レオポルド2世

assets.name: レセップス
assets.description: Ferdinand de Lesseps around 1869, mature French diplomat and canal promoter, receding grey hair, distinctive thick grey moustache, black Victorian frock coat and cream waistcoat, rolled engineering document.

assets.name: ウラービー
assets.description: Ahmed Urabi Egyptian military leader around 1882, adult Egyptian man with broad face, thick dark moustache, red fez, restrained dark blue nineteenth-century Egyptian officer jacket, closed constitutional papers.

assets.name: ムハンマド＝アフマド
assets.description: Muhammad Ahmad Sudanese Mahdist leader around 1885, adult Sudanese man with medium dark brown skin, short dark beard, white wrapped turban and simple cream robe, calm standing pose with closed book. assets.name: サモリ＝トゥーレ
assets.description: Samori Toure West African leader around 1890, mature Mandinka man with dark brown skin, close grey beard, white wrapped turban and light flowing West African robe with a restrained indigo outer cloth, closed document, dignified expression.

assets.name: キッチナー
assets.description: Herbert Horatio Kitchener around 1898, mature British officer with elongated face and thick brown-grey moustache, khaki pith helmet, late Victorian khaki tunic and trousers with restrained insignia, folded dispatch.

assets.name: マルシャン
assets.description: Jean-Baptiste Marchand French officer around 1898, adult man with short brown hair and small brown moustache, light expedition helmet, muted dark blue French colonial officer tunic and pale trousers, folded dispatch.

assets.name: ソールズベリ
assets.description: Robert Cecil third Marquess of Salisbury around 1898, older British prime minister, broad face, balding forehead, large full white-grey beard, black Victorian frock coat and white high collar, diplomatic papers.

assets.name: セシル＝ローズ
assets.description: Cecil Rhodes around 1895, middle-aged British politician in the Cape Colony, broad stocky face with small sandy moustache, neatly parted brown hair, brown-grey late Victorian suit and waistcoat, closed portfolio.

assets.name: ジョゼフ＝チェンバレン
assets.description: Joseph Chamberlain British colonial secretary around 1900, mature man with narrow clean-shaven face, short greying side-parted hair, distinctive monocle, black formal coat, restrained small orchid boutonniere, closed papers. Not Neville Chamberlain.

assets.name: ヴィルヘルム2世
assets.description: Wilhelm II German emperor around 1905, adult man with distinctive upturned dark moustache and short brown hair, restrained dark Prussian naval officer coat with modest gold epaulettes, closed naval dispatch, no helmet plume. Not Wilhelm I.

assets.name: ダイムラー
assets.description: Gottlieb Daimler around 1885, mature German engineer with balding forehead, short grey hair and full short grey beard and moustache, dark nineteenth-century suit and waistcoat, small closed engineering notebook.

assets.name: ディーゼル
assets.description: Rudolf Diesel around 1895, adult German engineer in his late thirties with neat dark moustache and short side-parted hair, small round spectacles, dark formal suit and waistcoat, closed engineering notebook.

assets.name: ブール人の一般の移住者
assets.description: Three distinct adult Boer settlers in southern Africa around 1840, modest nineteenth-century Dutch-descended farming clothing, brimmed hats, brown jacket and pale bonnet and long skirt, one small bundle and simple wagon wheel beside them. Ordinary migrants, no leaders, no firearms, no modern flags.

assets.name: ヘレロの一般の人びと
assets.description: Three ordinary adult Herero people in southern Africa around 1900, respectful varied faces with dark brown skin, modest late nineteenth-century clothing with brown and ochre cloth and a plain long dress, standing calmly together. No Victorian horned hats associated with later dress, no injury, captivity, spectacle or caricature.

assets.name: マフディー軍の一般の人びと
assets.description: Three ordinary adult Sudanese Mahdist followers around 1885, varied dark brown faces, white turbans and plain patched cream cotton robes with subdued blue and brown patches, standing calmly with closed banner cloth. No named leader, no magic, no violence or injuries.

assets.name: エチオピア軍の一般の人びと
assets.description: Three ordinary adult Ethiopian defenders in the 1890s, varied dark brown faces, plain white cotton wraps over brown and ochre clothing, one restrained nineteenth-century cartridge belt and a long rifle held vertically at rest. Dignified calm poses, no royal portrait, no action or violence.

assets.name: ベルベルの一般の人びと
assets.description: Three ordinary adult Amazigh Berber people in Morocco around 1911, varied medium-brown faces, modest cream and brown wool djellaba robes and simple head coverings, one folded indigo cloth, calm dignified standing poses. No leader, no modern national flags, no exotic decoration or violence.

assets.name: 人種隔離に反対する一般の人びと
assets.description: Three ordinary adult Black South African civil activists around 1912, dark brown skin with distinct faces, modest early twentieth-century suit and jacket and plain long dress, folded petition in one hand, dignified peaceful poses. No named leaders, no modern ANC logo, text, banners, chains or injuries.

assets.name: リベリアへの一般の入植者
assets.description: Three ordinary adult African-American settlers in Liberia in the 1820s, varied dark brown faces, simple early nineteenth-century jackets and bonnet with long dress, one small closed travelling trunk. Respectful dignified calm poses, no named leaders, no shackles, no contemporary national flags.

assets.name: イギリス軍の一般兵
assets.description: Three ordinary adult British military soldiers in Africa around 1898, distinct faces, restrained khaki late Victorian uniforms and pith helmets, brown leather belts, one rolled dispatch, rifles vertically at rest. No officers, no flags, no modern equipment, no combat or injury.

assets.name: フランス軍の一般兵
assets.description: Three ordinary adult French military soldiers in Africa around 1898, distinct European and African faces, restrained dark blue expedition uniforms and light cloth trousers, plain expedition headgear, folded dispatch, rifles vertically at rest. No officers, no flags, no modern equipment, no combat or injury.

assets.name: 重化学工業の模式図

Educational schematic building, not a named real factory.

assets.name: 自動車と内燃機関の模式図
assets.description: One small open 1890s motor car, dark green body, four narrow spoked wheels and exposed simple brass engine parts, no driver or people. Educational schematic example, not a specific patented design, no branding.

assets.name: 金とダイヤモンドの模式図
assets.description: A small tidy pile of raw gold nuggets beside two restrained pale blue faceted diamonds and a closed brown ore sack, crisp clear silhouettes, no numbers, labels, sparkles, glow, background or people.

assets.name: ドイツ軍艦の模式図
assets.description: A compact German imperial small steam gunboat around 1911, muted grey steel hull in side view, one small smokestack and mast, one restrained deck gun pointing away, no flag or lettering, no sea, wake, smoke cloud or people. Schematic historical vessel, not an exact named ship.
